Operations.Name: DeleteEnvironmentsById
Operations.Description: Delete an environment and all its associated git stacks, schedules, icons, and on-disk directories

Operations.Name: DeleteEnvironmentsByIdIcon
Operations.Description: Remove an environment's custom icon and reset it to the default "globe" icon

Operations.Name: DeleteEnvironmentsByIdNotificationsByNotificationId
Operations.Description: Remove a notification-channel link from an environment

Operations.Name: GetEnvironments
Operations.Description: List all Docker environments (hosts) known to Dockhand

Operations.Name: GetEnvironmentsById
Operations.Description: Get a single environment by id, including its parsed labels and public IP

Operations.Name: GetEnvironmentsByIdDiskWarning
Operations.Description: Get the disk-space warning thresholds for an environment

Operations.Name: GetEnvironmentsByIdIcon
Operations.Description: Get the custom icon image for an environment (raw image/webp bytes, not JSON)

Operations.Name: GetEnvironmentsByIdImagePrune
Operations.Description: Get the automatic image-prune schedule settings for an environment

Operations.Name: GetEnvironmentsByIdNotifications
Operations.Description: List notification channel configurations attached to an environment

Operations.Name: GetEnvironmentsByIdNotificationsByNotificationId
Operations.Description: Get one notification-channel link for an environment

Operations.Name: GetEnvironmentsByIdRemoteStacksDir
Operations.Description: Get the per-environment remote stacks directory used to stage stack files onto a direct (agentless) daemon

Operations.Name: GetEnvironmentsByIdTimezone
Operations.Description: Get the IANA timezone used for scheduling on an environment

Operations.Name: GetEnvironmentsByIdUpdateCheck
Operations.Description: Get the automatic container-image update-check schedule for an environment

Operations.Name: GetEnvironmentsDetectSocket
Operations.Description: Detect common Docker/Podman socket paths that exist on the Dockhand host

Operations.Name: PostEnvironments
Operations.Description: Register a new Docker environment (host)

Operations.Name: PostEnvironmentsByIdDiskWarning
Operations.Description: Save the disk-space warning thresholds for an environment (each field optional/independent)

Operations.Name: PostEnvironmentsByIdIcon
Operations.Description: Upload a custom icon for an environment (base64-encoded image, ~200KB limit)

Operations.Name: PostEnvironmentsByIdImagePrune
Operations.Description: Save the automatic image-prune schedule for an environment (registers/unregisters the croner job)

Operations.Name: PostEnvironmentsByIdNotifications
Operations.Description: Attach a notification channel to an environment

Operations.Name: PostEnvironmentsByIdRemoteStacksDir
Operations.Description: Set (or clear) the per-environment remote stacks directory for a direct (agentless) daemon

Operations.Name: PostEnvironmentsByIdTest
Operations.Description: Test connectivity to a saved environment's Docker/Hawser endpoint

Operations.Name: PostEnvironmentsByIdTimezone
Operations.Description: Set the IANA timezone for an environment and refresh its schedules to use it

Operations.Name: PostEnvironmentsByIdUpdateCheck
Operations.Description: Save the automatic image update-check schedule for an environment (registers/unregisters the croner job)

Operations.Name: PostEnvironmentsTest
Operations.Description: Test a Docker/Hawser connection configuration WITHOUT saving it as an environment

Operations.Name: PutEnvironmentsById
Operations.Description: Update an environment; renaming also renames its on-disk stacks/git-repos directories

Operations.Name: PutEnvironmentsByIdImagePrune
Operations.Description: Immediately run an image prune for an environment (outside its schedule)

Operations.Name: PutEnvironmentsByIdNotificationsByNotificationId
Operations.Description: Update a notification-channel link (enabled state and/or event type filter)

Fields.Name: ConnectionType
Fields.Description: how the host is reached: socket, direct, hawser-standard or hawser-edge

Fields.Name: HasHawserToken
Fields.Description: an agent's token is kept for the host; the token itself is never sent

Fields.Name: HasTlsKey
Fields.Description: a TLS key is kept for the host; the key itself is never sent

Fields.Name: HawserLastSeen
Fields.Description: when an agent that calls in was last heard from; empty for every other connection

Fields.Name: Host
Fields.Description: the host or its agent, for every connection but a socket

Fields.Name: SocketPath
Fields.Description: the Docker socket, for a socket connection; sent for the others too, and means nothing there
